title: Vampire Vape Tropical Passionfruit Splash 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Passionfruit Splash Nic Salt from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection blends three distinctive fruits for a rich, exotic vape. Curuba leads the mix with its tangy, peach-like tartness, paired with the sweet-tart bite of tropical Passionfruit. A base of mellow Banana smooths the blend, lending a creamy undertone that rounds out the fruitiness with warmth and depth. Formulated with nicotine salts for faster absorption and a smoother inhale, this 50VG/50PG blend is perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths. Vampire Vape e-liquids are made in the UK and trusted for their quality and innovation. The Tropical collection brings exotic inspiration to their award-winning range. Also available in Freebase, Shortfill and Concentrate formats.
